_comment: The evidence-level marker vocabulary the audit recognises, per output language. DATA, not prose: `assurance.ts` reads the same set, so a synonym added here and nowhere else is a bug rather than a difference of opinion. A marker is matched as a WHOLE backticked token, so a component name that merely contains a marker word is not a marker.
_why: writing-rules once promised free natural rendering while the audit accepted four exact Chinese strings. A real zh-CN run wrote the natural synonyms in good faith and had whole chapters reported as having no evidence level.
